RECOMMENDATIONS

Proposed tests

Winter awareness

Keep winter videos and gifting messages in rotation. Test shorter hooks, clear product shots, and a direct call to action.

New creative mix

Test static ads and carousels alongside the current videos. Compare cost per landing page view for traffic and cost per purchase for sales.

Focus by objective

Compare Broad, Interests, and Parents by traffic cost, traffic volume, and purchases. Test small budget shifts before scaling.
